gen-dafont-bloody-fs-nunito: Nunito reads friendly and modern, its round bowls and open stroke endings easy on the eye. Bloody then barges in above it, loud and commanding, while the plain sans carries on without raising its voice.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded hums along softly, its curves left open and its tall lowercase roomy. Bloody sits above with big round bowls and a commanding bark, so the sans-serif text feels like the quiet answer to a shout.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-quicksand: Quicksand draws tall, bulb-like bowls in bars of identical thickness, with endings that stop well short of the stem. Bloody's commanding heft makes it look sturdier by comparison.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-nunito: Bushcraft stretches out, widely spaced and artistic. Nunito follows in a plain sans with round bowls and open endings, so a long passage would go down gently, without any strain.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Wide-spaced and expressive, Bushcraft keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, while Pilcrow Rounded leaves its curves open and its counters generous. A long passage in the plain sans would feel warm and unhurried.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-alpino: Tall, tight and urban, Capture It towers with a huge x-height and near-sealed letters, earning its keep big and short. Alpino loosens everything, cozy and casual, with curve endings kept well apart in the sans.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and approachable, its round bowls opening wide. Capture It stands above it, towering and nearly sealed, so the plain sans gives the page room to breathe after each blunt heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Commanding and urban, Capture It towers with a tall x-height and barely any openings. Pilcrow Rounded sits beneath it, warm and open-curved, so the tightly shut heading meets a sans that lets the text breathe.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-quicksand: Capture It towers with a huge x-height and letters sealed almost shut, urban and commanding in every line. Quicksand answers with round, bulb-like bowls, a sans that feels open.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-familjen-gr: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills its lowercase with big bodies and plenty of nerve. Familjen Grotesk follows in a lively sans, its bowls left open on one side to keep things moving.
